input.overview: Agents 777 rewards repeated completions of the three drop targets. The first completion lights 2X Super Bonus and the spinner for 1,000 per spin; later completions advance 3X, flash 2X–4X, then light an Extra Ball lane. Lanes and targets also start or stop slot reels, and either saucer collects held combinations.
input.simpleOverview: In Agents 777, complete the three drop targets once to light 2X Super Bonus and the spinner for 1,000 per spin. Repeat the bank for 3X, flashing 2X–4X, then a lit Extra Ball lane. Use the numbered lanes and targets to stop matching slot symbols, then collect them at either saucer.
input.summary: Complete the drop bank to light the 1,000-point spinner and advance Super Bonus toward Extra Ball. Use the numbered lanes and targets to control the slot reels. When a winning pair holds, shoot either saucer to score the combination and release the reels.

quickInfo.summary: Lights 2X Super Bonus and raises the spinner to 1,000 points per spin.

quickInfo.name: Later bank completions
quickInfo.summary: The second lights 3X; the third flashes 2X–4X; the fourth makes them solid and can light Extra Ball.

quickInfo.name: Slot reels

steps.text: Complete the three drop targets once to light 2X Super Bonus and the spinner for 1,000 per spin.
Shoot the lit spinner for 1,000 points per spin.
Repeat the drop bank: the second completion lights 3X, the third flashes 2X–4X, and the fourth can light an Extra Ball lane.
Use the numbered lanes, drops, and standups to start or stop their corresponding slot reels.
When at least two winning symbols hold, shoot either saucer to collect the lit combination and release the reels.
Collect the lit Extra Ball lane after the fourth bank completion when the operator setting allows it.

buildsToward.title: 4X Super Bonus, a lit Extra Ball, and a slot collect

steps.text: Complete the drop bank four times on the same ball.
Use lanes and targets to stop a winning pair while building bonus.
Collect the pair at a saucer, then take the lit Extra Ball lane.

machineSetup: Confirm whether the fourth drop-bank completion awards Extra Ball, how many left-middle and upper-left lane repeats qualify awards, and whether saucers score every lit symbol or only completed winning combinations.
Test all three drops and their reset, 2X–4X lamps, spinner lamp, three slot reels, numbered lanes, standups and bumpers, both saucers, award lanes, bonus carryover, and tilt response.
